description: List calls, newest first. Status `refused` = an incoming call SAGOT didn't answer: `refusal` says why ({code, message, fix}), what the caller experienced (`handling`: rang_through = the phone kept ringing for a person, hung_up, message_played = a short notice) and how often it repeated within 10 minutes (`repeats`). Refused calls cost nothing and don't count as calls in usage. A queued call canceled before dialing carries the same `refusal`.
name: calls_list
